from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790687659/attempts/4b6740fb5c394cfaab2dd4985d9f6926/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-fe6fafb0.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    """Complete repeated horizontal bars to the longest observed right edge."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h = len(grid)
    w = len(grid[0]) if h else 0
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(r.count(v) for r in grid))
    # A solid horizontal run on an otherwise background row is a repeated bar.
    bars = {}
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        colors = {v for v in row if v != bg}
        if len(colors) != 1:
            continue
        color = next(iter(colors))
        inds = [c for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
        if inds != list(range(inds[0], inds[-1] + 1)):
            continue
        if all(v == bg or v == color for v in row):
            bars.setdefault(color, []).append((r, inds[0], inds[-1]))
    for color, items in bars.items():
        max_end = max(end for _, _, end in items)
        for r, start, end in items:
            for c in range(end + 1, max_end + 1):
                if out[r][c] == bg:
                    out[r][c] = 1
    return out
'''
